pages.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning carousel cover, page 1 of 5, portrait 3:4.
Primary request: Create a realistic overhead phone photo of one open notebook page on a warm wood desk. Match the supplied reference image's handmade study-note feeling: pale cream ruled paper, slight paper texture and perspective, a narrow strip of natural wood visible, soft natural window light, clear casual blue-black ballpoint handwriting, sparse translucent pale sage-green and pale yellow marker underlines. This is the master look for a five-page set.
Composition: Chinese hook is the largest first-level text in the upper half; exact English A/B is the second level. Lower third shows a single simple left-to-right blue-ink timeline: the same casually dressed woman first window-shopping empty-handed, then leaving with one shoe box. Use a small arrow to show progression. Simple open line drawing, no dense hatching.
Text (verbatim, preserve line breaks exactly):
“本来只想逛逛
最后多了一双鞋
end up doing / end up with”
Text accuracy: render every Chinese character and every English word exactly once and fully legibly. No extra labels, captions, page number, logo, watermark, shop signs, random writing, or faux brand.
Style/medium: believable photographed handwritten notebook page; blue-black natural handwriting, not typeset poster lettering. Complete English structures remain large and clear.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, gentle paper shadow, relaxed personal study note.
Color palette: warm cream paper, blue-black ink, tiny pale sage and pale yellow emphasis only.
Safety: all core text and drawings at least 8% from left/right edges and 10% above bottom edge; ample line spacing; never shrink or squeeze text at bottom.
Avoid: printed typography, digital cards, stickers, tape, clutter, neon, red/green correctness coding, giant symbols, dense crosshatching, duplicated people, malformed hands, garbled characters.
Aspect ratio: portrait 3:4.
pages.review: 实图通过：三行文字准确；空手逛街到提鞋盒的连续动作清楚，完整A/B醒目。

pages.prompt:

最后，我买了新鞋。

Lighting/mood: soft daylight, warm calm study note.

pages.review: 实图通过：中英文句子准确；同一鞋店用付款动作与鞋盒结果形成对照。

pages.prompt:

Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning carousel, page 3 of 5, portrait 3:4.
Primary request: Realistic overhead phone photo of one pale cream ruled notebook page on a warm wood desk, consistent with a handmade study-note set. Soft natural window light, clear blue-black ballpoint handwriting, very sparse pale sage and pale yellow marker underlines.
Composition: text-led page. Strong heading, then two clean structure blocks. Next to ‘end up doing’ draw a tiny hand paying for shoes; next to ‘end up with + 名词’ draw one shoe box. Final two lines form a boundary note with generous space. Drawings simple and open.
Text (verbatim, preserve line breaks exactly):
“看你想说动作还是结果
end up doing
最后做了什么
end up with + 名词
最后有了、得到了什么
同一件事可以两种说，
结果也不一定是坏事。”
Text accuracy: render every Chinese character, comma, full stop, plus sign, and English word exactly once and fully legibly. No other words or labels.
Style/medium: believable photographed handwritten notebook page; natural blue-black pen, slight paper texture, no printed poster typography.
Lighting/mood: soft calm daylight.
Safety: 8% side margins and 10% bottom margin; final boundary lines stay comfortably above bottom at full readable size.
Avoid: digital cards, stickers, tape, clutter, neon, red/green coding, extra text, logo, watermark, dense hatching, malformed hands, garbled text.
Aspect ratio: portrait 3:4.
pages.review: 实图通过：两种结构及非互斥、非负面边界准确；付款与鞋盒图示对应动作/结果。

pages.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning carousel, corrected page 4 self-test, portrait 3:4.
Primary request: Realistic overhead phone photo of one pale cream ruled notebook page on a warm wood desk, in a consistent handmade blue-black ballpoint study-note style. Soft natural window light, sparse pale sage/yellow underline accents.
Composition: heading at top. Two neutral question sections sharing one dining table and pizza setting. Upper small line drawing: a blank-screen smartphone beside a whole pizza box, conveying ordering; the phone screen must contain no letters or words. Lower small line drawing: the same pizza box with exactly three triangular slices left. All answer options use identical blue-black ink and equal weight. Absolutely no answer hints.
Text (verbatim, preserve line breaks exactly):
“按表达重点，选更贴切的一项
1. 最后做了什么：点披萨。
We ended up ___.
A. ordering pizza
B. with a pizza
2. 最后剩下什么：三片披萨。
We ended up ___.
A. ordering pizza
B. with three slices left”
Text accuracy: render every Chinese character, number, colon, period, underscore, and English word exactly. Each blank is exactly three underline strokes ‘___’. The only visible letters or words anywhere in the image must be the verbatim teaching text above.
Style/medium: believable photographed handwritten notebook page, very legible blue-black handwriting.
Safety: at least 8% side and 10% bottom safe space; keep last option full size and well above bottom.
Avoid: phone UI words such as PIZZA or ORDER; any extra text; answer cues; red/green coding; checkmarks; crosses; circled choices; printed cards; stickers; tape; clutter; logo; watermark; garbled text; dense hatching.
Aspect ratio: portrait 3:4.
pages.review: 修正后实图通过：手机屏无多余文字，盒内正好三片；选项同色同权重，无答案暗示。首版保存在图4_含多余界面文字_中间稿.png。

pages.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: Xiaohongshu English-learning carousel, page 5 answer review, portrait 3:4.
Input image: Image 1 is the required page-4 scene and layout reference.
Primary request: Create a new photographed handwritten notebook answer page that strictly preserves Image 1's same dining table, blank-screen phone, pizza box, exactly three remaining slices, pale cream ruled paper, wood desk, natural light, blue-black pen style, scale, and framing. Replace the self-test options with the exact answer-and-reason text below. Add only two small pale sage check marks beside answer 1 and answer 2. No new scene or knowledge.
Text (verbatim, preserve line breaks exactly):
“答案与判断点
1. We ended up ordering pizza.
说最后做的动作。
2. We ended up with three slices left.
说最后留下的东西。
两种结构都成立，看要表达的结果。”
Text accuracy: every Chinese character, number, comma, period, and English word exactly once and fully legible. No other text. Phone screen stays blank.
Style/medium: same believable photographed blue-black handwritten notebook as Image 1, sparse pale sage and pale yellow underlines.
Safety: 8% side and 10% bottom margins; final boundary sentence at normal readable size and comfortably above bottom.
Avoid: changes to the core phone/pizza scenes, adding or removing pizza slices, extra labels, UI words, logo, watermark, printed typography, digital cards, clutter, garbled text.
Aspect ratio: portrait 3:4.
pages.review: 实图通过：继承图4手机、整盒披萨与三片剩余场景；答案和非互斥边界准确完整。

overallReview: 实图通过。5页均为1086x1448，精确3:4；文字、动作、选项中性、结构边界与安全区均已逐张查看。
